name: Recurrent HSV-associated erythema multiforme (suppressive)
advice: Daily antiviral is taken continuously (not only during attacks) for at least 6 months, then tapered to see if attacks return. Use lip sunscreen — sunlight triggers cold sores. Creatinine at baseline if kidney disease or elderly.
